entry.title: Subject Extraction for Scene Reconstruction in VFX — BCON26

media:group.media:title: Subject Extraction for Scene Reconstruction in VFX — BCON26
media:group.media:description:
"Subject Extraction for Scene Reconstruction in VFX" by Vincent Dorenkamp at Blender Conference 2026 Most VFX workflows start with the reconstruction of the scene based on the footage, in order to integrate new CG assets with the existing geometry and lighting of the scene. During that process an important step is the separation of the subject(s) from the background.
In this talk Vincent will showcase a custom machine learning model for extracting subjects from footage for a better cg integration workflow. We'll look at the current state-of-the-art in image matting, this new model's architecture, color reconstruction for half-transparent subjects and how to work safely with external libraries in extensions asynchronously. – Learn more about Blender Conference 2026 at https://conference.blender.org/2026/ #b3d #BCON26

entry.title: Audio Nodes: Live Sound, Living Geometry — BCON26

media:group.media:title: Audio Nodes: Live Sound, Living Geometry — BCON26
media:group.media:description: "Audio Nodes: Live Sound, Living Geometry" by Cem Özcan at Blender Conference 2026 Audio Nodes is a Blender add-on that turns sound into a live creative input for Blender. Instead of treating audio as data baked to the timeline, it lets artists build sound-reactive systems with familiar node workflows using sequencers, samplers, audio filters, MIDI controls, FFT analysis, and real-time links to geometry nodes, shader nodes, or any Blender property that is driver-friendly.This workshop shows how audio can become a first-class driver inside Blender, enabling scenes that pulse, deform, glow, and perform in direct response to live sound. – Learn more about Blender Conference 2026 at https://conference.blender.org/2026/ #b3d #BCON26
